patch.value: Minimum-SDK consumer fixture installs development-tool peers it cannot satisfy

Tracks gh:unbraind/pm-github#199 (filed 2026-10-29, missed by the blind issue watch; the three failures already covered by gh:unbraind/pm-github#197 are tracked separately). test/minimum-sdk-consumer.test.ts spreads all devDependencies into the consumer root and then overrides the CLI to the declared minimum (2026.10.17), while the manifest now installs pm-ops 2026.10.26 whose peer requires CLI >=2026.10.20 — an unsatisfiable graph, npm ERESOLVE before any packed import or declaration check runs. The PR #194 checks still fail as of run 41330041504. Fix the fixture to install only runtime dependencies plus the enforced minimum CLI (isolating the witness from development-tool peer requirements) so the packed extension, authored SDK imports and shipped declarations are verified at the floor independently of the development lock.
